items.title: The 6th House: Sickness and Servitude?
items.summary:
"Into each life a little rain must fall," as Ella Fitzgerald sang.

The 6th house was referred to by Roman astrologers as 'Mala Fortuna', or 'Bad Luck', and is associated with illness, thankless tasks, and hard work (in addition to a few positive affiliations, such as pets and employees).

By interpreting planets associated with the 6th house, specific ailments and problems can be predicted—where, when, and what these may be—and thereby potentially mitigated, optimised, or evaded with good astrological counsel.

By looking at general indicators of health and disease in a chart, and specifically the 6th house, astrologers can help their clients (and themselves) with supportive strategies to ameliorate the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.

items.title: October Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for October 2026, with astrologer Chris Brennan. 

This month is dominated by a tumultuous Venus retrograde in Scorpio, kicking off alongside intense hard aspects to Mars and Pluto, which will dredge up some challenging things from the past.

Tensions are further heightened as Mercury slows down and stations retrograde in Scorpio later in the month, bringing communication breakdowns and the need for significant retooling.

I explore the historical precedents for these transits and break down how to navigate this tough astrological weather before the planets finally station direct and offer resolution in mid-November.

This is episode 551 of The Astrology Podcast.
